youtube.title: Why Your Salt Packet Says Iodised (It Saved Millions of Brains)
youtube.description: Open your salt packet and read one word: iodised. It's there because of sick trout, a mountain range that forgot something, and thousands of schoolgirls in Ohio. Iodine is the one element your thyroid can't work without, and mountain and inland soils lost theirs long ago. Adding a pinch to salt, the one food everyone eats, protects children's brains. That's the hidden why. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained

sources: Marine D, Kimball OP. 'The prevention of simple goiter in man.' Archives of Internal Medicine, 1920 (Akron schoolgirl trial)

Markel H. 'When it rains it pours: endemic goiter, iodized salt, and David Murray Cowie, MD.' American Journal of Public Health, 1987 (Michigan 1924)
Zimmermann MB. 'Research on iodine deficiency and goiter in the 19th and early 20th centuries.' Journal of Nutrition, 2008 (iodine discovered 1811, Coindet 1820, Chatin 1850s)
